title: Shopdotapp: B2B e-commerce engine
summary: Catalog, vendor onboarding and automated Shopify and WooCommerce sync for brands and retailers.
impact: 60% performance boost; the platform raised venture funding after launch.
problem: Retailers and brands needed a scalable platform to manage catalogs, orders and vendors across fragmented storefronts.
solution: Built an end-to-end B2B e-commerce system with catalog management and vendor onboarding modules, plus automated Shopify and WooCommerce sync engines and order workflows powered by MySQL optimisations.
result: Boosted system performance by 60%, significantly reduced data sync failures, and enabled smooth onboarding of high-volume merchants.
